escena: SCENE (shelf audit, store aisle in Mexico City, midday): an EXTREME CROP of Nexa with her head upright and almost frontal, gaze turned to the shelf off frame-right. Verify the cut by these visible landmarks: the RIGHT border runs down the CENTRELINE of her nose, cutting the bridge, the nose tip and her mouth in HALF. Only the near eye, ONE nostril and HALF the lips are inside the image. The far eye is ENTIRELY OUTSIDE the image, with not even its inner corner visible. The top edge cuts her forehead just above the near eyebrow; the top of her head is outside. Her hair runs off the bottom edge. The visible half of her face and her hair fill the entire picture: no shoulders, no aisle, no room around her. This is a photograph composed this close in the camera. The face is sharply cut by the ACTUAL RIGHT BORDER of the image: there is NO vertical shelf, post, partition, blur or foreground obstruction anywhere on that right edge. Skin reaches the rightmost pixel where the frame cuts the nose and lips; the second eye simply never fits inside the camera frame. The only foreground object is the horizontal near shelf lip along the BOTTOM, physically below her chin and never beside or across her face. THE LIGHT ON HER FACE IS BOUNCED OFF A WALL OF INK-BLUE PACKAGING on the shelf just out of frame to the left, so a cool azure cast falls across her forehead, cheek and the near side of her jaw, and a narrow band of that ink-blue shelf shows at the very left edge of the picture. Hard midday daylight from the storefront rakes in over it and keeps the highlights clean. At the bottom left corner, thrown far out of focus, a TINY ORANGE shelf marker, visibly narrower than the visible eye, sits as the only warm accent, mostly hidden behind the near shelf edge and dissolved into an unrecognizable soft orange bokeh spot, never a readable rectangular label. Caught at the instant she narrows her eye to read a shelf label. She wears a fine light heather-grey knit sweater, of which only a thread of collar shows. She looks at the shelf, never at the camera. 85mm at f/1.8, extremely close. Everything is completely unbranded, no readable text anywhere.

nota: Prueba local de palanca fragmento solicitada por el operador, Nano Banana 2.1 4K/thinking high. Receta F6 aprobada como punto de partida; misma escena, corte, luz, color y lecho. Anclas actuales resueltas por foto:prompt, sin enviar el plate Sunburst. Comparación visual con el histórico; no A/B controlado porque cambiaron las referencias vigentes. V1 conserva buena materia pero asoma el ojo lejano y la etiqueta es excesiva. V2 cambia sólo los marcadores del corte y la escala física del acento; misma identidad, registro, escena, luz y controles del motor. La reserva de campo al margen no es compatible con este crop; se registra el gate completo sin afirmar PASS. V2 respetó un ojo pero inventó oclusión vertical y falló el lecho (blanco 2,05:1). V3 impide expresamente esa oclusión y dirige la sombra física del mismo borde de estante. No se modifica ningún plate.
